goal: Prevent the HTTP server from reading new socket data while a previous request is still being processed
Avoids prematurely reopening the TCP receive window and defeating backpressure, fixing flaky tests
reviewability: CI is failing, so verify whether the failure belongs to this PR before deep review

agreement: Substantive support for strictly serializing request processing without pipelining (winterrdog)
